text: The stable window where the meals are handed in
why: ¶25 states she ran to the window through which she was accustomed to hand the meals.

text: The small table in the stable
why: ¶25 states Hunter was seated at the small table inside the window.

text: Monday evening, the maid and the stranger at the stable window
why: ¶20 places the maid's supper trip at a few minutes after nine on Monday night, and ¶25 has the stranger return to the window.
¶21–25 give the events from the maid's point of view, and ¶20 names Edith Baxter as the maid who carried the supper.
